title: azimuth_panhuman
description:
Automated cell type annotation using Pan-human Azimuth, a neural network
pre-trained on a pan-human single-cell atlas by the Satija lab.

Dataset input.title: Dataset input
Dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple         parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml                 blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

input.description: The input (query) data to be annotated

input_layer.description:
The layer in the input data containing raw (unnormalized) counts.
Azimuth performs its own normalization internally and expects
integer counts; if not provided, `.X` is used.

input_var_gene_names.description:
The name of the .var column in the input data containing gene
symbols

input_reference_gene_overlap.description:
The minimum number of genes required to be present in both the
query dataset and the Azimuth reference gene panel

output_obs_predictions.description:
In which `.obs` column to store the most granular ('final level')
predicted cell type label

output_obs_probability.description:
In which `.obs` column to store the confidence score of the
`--output_obs_predictions` label (calibrated for `--model_version v1`).

output_obs_predictions_broad.description:
In which `.obs` column to store the refined broad-granularity cell
type label

output_obs_predictions_medium.description:
In which `.obs` column to store the refined medium-granularity cell
type label

output_obs_predictions_fine.description:
In which `.obs` column to store the refined fine-granularity cell
type label

output_obsm_embedding.description:
In which `.obsm` slot to store the extracted Azimuth embeddings.
Only used if `--extract_embeddings` is set.

output_obsm_umap.description:
In which `.obsm` slot to store the UMAP projection.
Only used if `--umap_embeddings` is set.

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

model.title: Model
model.description:
Arguments controlling the pre-trained Azimuth neural network. There is
no reference/training step: the model is fixed and its weights are
downloaded automatically on first use, unless a local copy is
provided with `--model`.

Path to a pre-downloaded Azimuth inference model (a `.keras` file,
as published on Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/20401417)

model_version.description: Which version of the pre-trained Azimuth model to use

eval_batch_size.description: Batch size used during model inference and minibatched annotation.

normalization_override.description:
Skip Azimuth's internal normalization and treat `--input_layer`
(or `.X`) as already log-normalized, instead of raw counts.
Counts must be normalized to a target sum of 10000 per cell
(i.e

norm_check_batch_size.description: Number of cells sampled to determine whether the input counts are already normalized.

refine_labels.description:
Whether to post-process the raw hierarchical predictions into
broad, medium and fine labels with consistent granularity across
cell types, stored in `--output_obs_predictions_broad`,
`--output_obs_predictions_medium` and `--output_obs_predictions_fine`.

embeddings and umap.title: Embeddings and UMAP
embeddings and umap.description:
Arguments controlling extraction of the Azimuth neural network's
internal cell embeddings, and an optional UMAP projection thereof.

extract_embeddings.description: Whether to extract the Azimuth neural network embeddings for each cell.

umap_embeddings.description:
Whether to compute a UMAP projection of the extracted embeddings.
Requires `--extract_embeddings true`.

umap_n_neighbors.description: Number of neighbors to consider for each point in the UMAP.

umap_metric.description: Distance metric to use for the UMAP.

umap_min_dist.description: Minimum distance between points in the UMAP projection.

umap_seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility of the UMAP.

umap_spread.description: Scales the effective scale of embedded points in the UMAP.

umap_verbose.description: Whether to print UMAP progress to the log.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
